A true plug-and-play HDMI switcher, supporting up to four 4K HDR sources to one screen

The WyreStorm EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a powerful plug-and-play 4K switcher solution. With up to 18Gbps pure HDMI support, which allows up to four 4K HDR sources to be routed to a single display. The EXP-SW-0401-H2 is capable of auto switching, giving the user the convenience of simply turning on their favorite device without the requiring manual intervention. Furthermore, the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is equipped with signal compensation, allowing an extender or splitter to connect to its output without degrading or delaying the signal.

A trend you may notice is the plug-and-play features WyreStorm’s Essentials product line possesses and it doesn’t stop at our switchers. You can find the same auto EDID and HDCP negotiation found in other Essentials products, but specifically signal regeneration is what makes WyreStorm’s Essentials switchers the king of plug-and-play!

While the EXP-SW-0401-H2 is a stand-alone device, sometimes wiring to the display is too long for a standard HDMI cable, or maybe there are additional displays added. Because of its signal regeneration feature, additional devices can be connected to the output of the switch, like an extender set or splitter, all without signal delay or degradation.
